_comment: Base config, shared across environments. Environment-specific values (paths, log level, polling frequency, expected SDK version) live in appsettings.Development.json / appsettings.Production.json and are layered on top based on the DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT variable - see README 'Promoting from Dev to Production'. PortPro.AccessToken/RefreshToken and Sage50.Password are intentionally blank here - set them via 'dotnet user-secrets' for local dev (UserSecretsId is already configured) or PortProSage__PortPro__AccessToken-style environment variables in production. See README 'Configuration'.
